About Biltech

Digital Solutions Built Around Real Business Problems

We help Penang SMEs connect Google, their website and WhatsApp around the way customers actually find and contact them.

Get Free Advice

Local understanding.
Practical thinking.

Start with the business.
Then choose the technology.

A business owner should not need to become a digital marketing expert to make a sensible decision.

A customer might find you on Google, visit your website to check a service and ask a question on WhatsApp. If the details disagree or the reply never comes, that customer is left unsure.

We look at those steps together, review what you already use and explain where changes could help. The starting point is your business problem, not a list of tools to buy.
